note: Per-position group sequence of the reservation trigger (T2-SEQ-001).
Every parameter here is a STOPPED-state install parameter: t2_workflow.py turns
it into one TEMPlate row per group (argument + delta_q) and installs it with
TEMPLate:INSTall. Changing this file therefore needs a re-run of the install and
the scan - it never needs a firmware build or a re-flash.
The codes follow the reservation sequence of the node-sequence branch
SP8T channel steps every second item and the polarization is the item's parity).
The first entry is the built-in default: ONE row per role, i.e. no sequence.
